propositions: A parent removed in Jira is not synced inbound because the fetcher omits absent-parent from the snapshot (key absent rather than present-and-falsy)
The inbound differ refuses to emit parent_id=None, conflating 'queried and no parent' with 'parent key unresolvable', so a clear never reaches the apply layer even if the snapshot carried it
The fix requires positive evidence that the peer once had the parent (stored via binding_store peer-parent record) to avoid clearing locally-set parents on truncated or failed parent-map reads
An inbound parent clear must be gated by both peer evidence AND managed_refs, since managed_refs alone cannot prove the peer ever held the parent
The same-pass outbound suppression (via _OUTBOUND_TO_INBOUND_FIELD mapping) cannot protect a locally-set parent unless outbound actually writes it that pass, leaving a degraded-pass residual window
Rollout is safe-by-construction: absent peer evidence degrades to local-wins, so no bindings will clear parents until observations accumulate across passes
